steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Watch out!

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: What even—
Flames burst forth above their heads, raining cinders down from the ceiling, igniting the flour and oil atop the stove. In an instant, the kitchen is a sea of fire.

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: *cough* *cough* *cough*!

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: You... go... I'll be fine!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Cover your mouth and nose! Don't talk!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I'm not too good with this move yet... let's give it a try.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: 'Scuse me, just duck.
Blaze grabs a knife, then slices her palm open. Gradually a whirlwind forms in Blaze's hand, then expands straight outward into a blast wave.
The violent surge of air sweeps the whole room. In a blink, she's put the fires out, and strewn the cookware about in shambles.

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: What a skill you have... Could you be...

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: ...Duoxie.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You're welcome—

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hm?
Looking up again, Blaze sees the lamp's frame is charred black, red-hot metal peeking through the burnt coating. It's on the verge of falling.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Mo Bufu, move!
Blaze grabs the old man's arm, trying to pull him to one side, but the lamp's already falling—
With a stifled crack of thunder, the remains of the fixture are abruptly flung to one side, and smashed hard against the wall.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Are you alright there?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Leizi?! What are YOU doing here?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: ...Maybe I should ask, what are you doing here?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: But we can talk about you later...

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Could this be a repeat of the Ding Feng Lou fire last month...?
Lin Qingyan scans her surroundings. The kitchen chefs are in a frenzied jumble, but her gaze quickly locks onto a masked figure among them.
...Who seems to meet her gaze, then turns and vanishes into the crowd.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Blaze, stay here! Keep Mo Bufu safe!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hey! Where are you going?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: *cough* *cough*... Jeez, this smoke is killing me.

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: *cough* *hack*... On that pillar there, there's a breaker...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: There's, uh... a lot of them here... Which one do I pull...?
Flitting like a fowl, Lin Qingyan has her target cornered in just a few spry leaps.
Mere meters separate them, but so smoky is the air that she can't quite make out their silhouette.
Just as he makes to run again, a thunderclap strikes next to his feet.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Hold it!

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Move another inch, and the next bolt is hitting your head.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Answer my questions.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Why set fire to Ding Feng Lou? Is your target Mo Bufu, or someone else?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: All the previous incidents, they were your doing too, weren't they?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Also... the scrollery?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: You... and your accomplices, must have some aim in all these actions—what is it?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Not talking? Then I'll take you back to the Judicial Review Office, for a nice long questioning—

steps.name: Masked Individual
steps.text: Deputy Minister Lin, surely you wouldn't ask if you didn't know the answer already?

steps.name: Masked Individual
steps.text: Can you not see the truth, or do you simply pretend you can't because you don't dare to?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: What—

steps.name: Masked Individual
steps.text: The Office is a good place, but I don't plan on visiting it for now.

steps.name: Masked Individual
steps.text: Besides, when your will wavers, the thunder you throw isn't so frightening.

steps.name: Masked Individual
steps.text: It's time you opened your eyes.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Wait—
And with that, the masked figure is on the move. Just as Lin Qingyan would give chase, the ceiling sprinklers start up out of nowhere.
Ice-cold water pours down, soaking her head to foot.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Leizi—

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You alright?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Dammit.

steps.name: Flustered Chef
steps.text: The customers are all safely out of the way, there's just a few in shock. Thank goodness no one was injured...

steps.name: Flustered Chef
steps.text: We've reported it to the authorities. The mandarins should be here any moment...

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: Don't we have a mandarin here already?

steps.name: Flustered Chef
steps.text: Head Chef... you're...

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: I'm fine... I owe it to this girl.

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: There's nothing left for you to do here. Go on, go home.
Once the chefs leave, Lin Qingyan locks the door to the room.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Mr. Mo, if I could have a word or two with you.

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: You know this girl, madam?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: She's a friend of mine.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Chef Mo, she's on the trail of a really important case. Would it be alright if you, uh, tried to answer her questions...?

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: Hmph... I don't like what the mandarins get up to, but I don't like to spurn a favor either. You saved my life today, and that's more favor than I'll ever repay.

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: Go ahead, then. Ask away.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: I'm looking for one of your restaurant's chefs. He's a witness in a case.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: I believe ten years ago, he was working in the Ministry of Justice death row prison, making last meals for convicts.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: A chef who only makes last meals... How exactly did he pass the Ding Feng Lou exams?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Ding Feng Lou serves all manner of mandarins every year at the Feast of a Hundred Delicacies. That means every chef's background must be clear as day for the record.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: I imagine he shouldn't be hard to find.

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: What exactly do you want me to say, madam?

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: First my restaurant catches fire for no reason. Now you say we have a chef who made meals for dead men. Should I even bother to open Ding Feng Lou again?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: I understand your situation, sir. That's why I'm choosing to ask you these things in private.

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: Whatever. It's not like I can't admit to my own past.

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: The chef you're looking for, the death row caterer Mo Xiaoliu, that was me.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: I thought so...

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: And making last meals is nothing shameful. The powerful need to eat, and so do the powerless.

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: My cooking skills come from that prison, making last meals for death row convicts from all corners of the country.

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: As for changing my name and hiding my identity, I just didn't want to make any trouble for this restaurant.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I'm beginning to... sort of admire you.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Do you remember, ten years ago, a convict admitted to the prison by the name of Gu Quan?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: If you don't remember the name, you should at least remember that some decades ago, he was the one and only person to be released from death row.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Wait! You mean my dad? Why'd my dad get the death penalty?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Blaze!

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: You mean Gu Quan? He was your father?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Yeah...

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: So you remember him...

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: I do... all too well.

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: I spent so many years in there making last meals. I met countless horrific scoundrels, endless connivers. As each one of them ate before they left, the look in their eyes, it was always more or less the same.

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: But I'd never seen someone whose eyes were so clear, so clean, so free of anything.

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: He wasn't like the other convicts. In his time, he never wept, never howled, and never screamed injustice, not even on the day he was imprisoned.

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: Even I found it strange how a man like him could end up on death row.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Why would... my dad...

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Then do you know, at the time, what charges Gu Quan was sentenced to death on?

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: Not at the time...

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Not at the time?

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: But one year later, when I joined Ding Feng Lou and began taking part in the Feast of a Hundred Delicacies, I came across a menu for a Feast from a few years before—

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: That was when I learned that at that Feast, Gu Quan served a dish to the True Lung. It just so happens, that was the same dish this girl pulled down earlier. 'Medley of Whites'.

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: But next to that dish, he placed a steamed flour bun, and in it... was a filling of red pickled tofu.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: So... what does it mean? Why would he get locked up just for serving that?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Lin Qingyan, aren't you gonna say anything?

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: Your relative told you the story of the Grand Preceptor, but never told you her eventual fate?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Her... fate?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Forty years ago, the Grand Preceptor plotted to assassinate the True Lung. She committed suicide after it failed. Every single one of her underlings was arrested and trialed, and their numbers were over a thousand...

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: When Gu Quan served that dish at the Feast, it signified redressing her for her treason. It made the True Lung furious.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: No way... my dad told me so many times, the Grand Preceptor was loyal to the country, the people, the whole realm! How the hell could she be a traitor?!

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: The history books have it that way, yes.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: And they're right?!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Lin Qingyan, if everything written in them is true, what the hell are you investigating?!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: And... and besides, my dad didn't actually get killed, right? Doesn't that prove, like, at least some people from the court believed the Grand Preceptor and my dad were both innocent?!

spans.text: And... and besides, my dad didn't actually get killed, right? Doesn't that prove, like, at least
people from the court believed the Grand Preceptor and my dad were both innocent?!

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: That's a sticking point, yes. If Gu Quan was imprisoned as part of the Grand Preceptor case, why would they free him afterwards?

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: It stuck with me too... You see, after entering prison, Gu Quan had two visitors, and both were people I happened to know...

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: One was the person delivering his meal. Yu Cheng, deputy minister of the Office at the time.

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: And the other was the one who brought him out... former Minister of Rites, Ning Shu.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: What...?!

steps.name: Voice Outside the Door
steps.text: Quick! This way! Surround the place immediately!

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Dammit... why now...?!

steps.name: Chen Che
steps.text: What a coincidence. One step ahead of me, Deputy Minister Lin.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: I'd just arrived. A coincidence, indeed.

steps.name: Chen Che
steps.text: The Judicial Review Office is investigating the Ding Feng Lou fire. I ask all of you to be cooperative.

steps.name: Chen Che
steps.text: Lin Qingyan, and the girl next to you, come with me.
